# UX-R1/P3-03B2 — Chart.js Native Renderer Candidate

**Status:** PR candidate, NOT MERGED / NOT DEPLOYED.  
**Baseline:** `main@ab092d5bec3985c693849e275a065d3a744569ad` (P3-03B1 merged, 457/457 postmerge regression).  
**Dependencies:** pinned `chart.js@4.5.1` and `@kurkle/color@0.3.4`, installed through existing `npm ci --ignore-scripts` with registry SRI integrity. The UMD bundle generated by `tools/build-chartjs-offline-asset.mjs` is verified before the Native stage builds.

## Implementation

- The **authored** `src/web/00-document-head.html` contains one fixed build marker instead of the prior external Google Charts loader. `tools/native-inline-vendor.mjs` replaces it during Native staging with the **exact pinned Chart.js UMD bytes** via `chartVendorBytes(root)`. This keeps the Native **24-entry layout** (7 GS + 16 HTML partials + Index), and avoids committing a 208 KB vendor copy, loading Chart.js from a CDN at runtime, or increasing the supported Apps Script file count.
- Both `tools/build-apps-script-multifile.mjs` and read-only `tools/native-release-inspection.mjs` use the same deterministic compiler. Stage parity now correctly compares `00-document-head.html` with the **compiled vendored bytes**, while all other Native files remain source-exact. `--check` does not write. The generated stage is byte-stable if dependencies remain pinned.
- Dashboard `drawCharts()` continues consuming exactly the public `dashboardSummary.byVillage/byMonth/byDiseaseGroup/byRisk` arrays for guests, or the preexisting filtered `allData` groupings after authentication. Chart.js renders horizontal village bars, monthly line, and two doughnut charts. Source KPI calculations remain unchanged. Accessible P3-03A tables still consume the exact same series. Empty charts do not draw synthetic categories.
- Each chart has an explicitly bounded canvas parent and a Map of Chart.js instances; redraw destroys prior instances and handles empty charts without a lingering old canvas. Rendering is synchronous with `animation:false`.
- `captureDashboard()` stops and updates active charts before `html2canvas(captureArea)`; it checks live loading/error, session token, request revision and authentication mode before/after screenshot. Only aggregate `captureArea` is captured. Existing Excel export retains its private auth gate.
- Boot now starts Dashboard loading after the synchronous inline Chart.js UMD is available, without a Google Charts network callback. No new Apps Script RPC, privilege, schema, report generation, installer or One-Click modifications.

## Specific limits and gates

- CI uses an isolated Node VM with mock `Chart`, canvas, document and screenshot; this is **not** proof of actual Chart.js pixels, Canvas 2D rendering in a real browser, long Thai label layout or correct PNG content in Apps Script HTML Service.
- Before authorizing **TEST** deployment: verify real Chart.js render, all four Canvas charts, 2x PNG showing chart contents, screen-reader chart tables, 360/390/768/1024/1440px and 200% zoom, portrait/landscape and iframe conditions; public-only and authorized datasets; logout/refresh race; no console errors; and rollback backup.
- **Critical deployment guard:** the existing `tools/deploy-g34-clasp.sh` rejects a currently deployed Native24 remote source because it recognizes only Legacy2/Native13 backup layouts. It must be separately patched + tested to permit **exact matching Native24** before a new `--preflight` can succeed. Do not bypass guards; this PR does not authorize clasp push/update-deployment.
- Native source Head now includes a build marker; tools that intentionally concatenate authored HTML without the compiler (e.g. simple test helpers) inspect its architecture and script functions but are **not** the release artifact. The canonical release is the byte-verified Native stage.
- Production release remains `HOLD` under P6, even if UI CI passes. The deployed isolated TEST App is still Version 11. Separate Product Owner approvals are required for Merge and TEST deployment.
